name: WikiArt.org
summary: Visual art encyclopedia: searchable database of paintings with artist biographies and artwork descriptions.
description: WikiArt is a visual art database of paintings and photographs, organised by artist, art movement, school and group, genre, field, nationality, century and art institution, with cross-indexes of artworks by style, genre and media. Artwork pages carry details such as the artist and completion year; the site also shows an artwork of the day, short films, art news and a shop for prints and reproductions.
contains: browse by artist, art movement, school and group, genre, field, nationality, century and art institution
cross-indexes: artworks by style, by genre and by media
artwork pages with artist, completion year and other details
artwork of the day and a short film of the month
available in English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Russian, Ukrainian and Chinese
art news posts plus a shop for prints, posters and reproductions
